units.source_text: 她吟时脉脉含情，娇羞无限。

en.t: As she recited the verse, her feeling showed tenderly, and her shy charm was boundless.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想道：“世间女子个个可爱，教我难于舍弃。

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "Every woman in the world is lovable, making it hard for me to give any of them up.
This is what torments me so terribly!" he replied:
